review: 701.12c-1: cannot_gain_life had B losing 15 life while A could not gain; an exchange that can't be completed does nothing (701.12a, the card's ruling, Forge's LifeExchangeEffect), so both life totals now stay put.

701.12g-1: cannot_gain_life still set the toughness to 7 although B's life could not rise; under 701.12a nothing is exchanged (Forge's LifeExchangeVariantEffect agrees), so Tree of Perdition now stays 0/13.
701.12d-2: added; no scenario exercised the 701.12d clause that cards are exchanged only when one player owns them all. It uses Aura swap on an Arcanum Wings owned by A or by B.

scenarios.title: An exchange happens entirely or not at all
decisions: A casts Switcheroo targeting Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant, tapping five Islands.

variants.label: both_legal
variants.expected: A controls Hill Giant and B controls Grizzly Bears. Switcheroo moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: one_target_destroyed
variants.delta: With Switcheroo on the stack, B casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain, and Shock resolves first.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. Switcheroo resolves with only one target left and no exchange occurs: Hill Giant stays under B's control.

scenarios.title: Exchanging control of two permanents with the same controller does nothing
decisions: A casts Switcheroo targeting Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant, tapping five Islands.

variants.label: different_controllers
variants.expected: Each player gains control of the other's creature at the same time. A controls Typhoid Rats and Hill Giant; B controls Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: same_controller
variants.delta: Switcheroo targets Grizzly Bears and Typhoid Rats, both controlled by A.
variants.expected: Switcheroo resolves and does nothing. A still controls Grizzly Bears and Typhoid Rats; B still controls Hill Giant.

scenarios.title: Exchanging life totals sets each player to the other's previous total, unless a player can't gain life

setup.notes: In the cannot_gain_life variant Everlasting Torment is added to B's battlefield.

decisions: A activates Magus of the Mirror ({T}, sacrifice it) targeting B.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: plain
variants.expected: A's life total goes from 5 to 20 and B's from 20 to 5. Magus of the Mirror is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: cannot_gain_life
variants.delta: Everlasting Torment is on the battlefield under B's control (players can't gain life).
variants.expected: No part of the exchange occurs: A stays at 5 and B stays at 20. Magus of the Mirror is in A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's LifeExchangeEffect changes neither life total when the higher player can't lose life or the lower player can't gain life.

scenarios.title: Exchanging two zones moves the cards of each, even when one zone is empty
decisions: A casts Harness Infinity, tapping the four Swamps and three Forests.
Both players pass; Harness Infinity resolves.

variants.label: both_zones_full
variants.expected: A's hand and graveyard are exchanged: Grizzly Bears and Shock are in A's graveyard and Hill Giant is in A's hand. Harness Infinity is exiled.

variants.label: empty_graveyard
variants.expected: The exchange still happens: Grizzly Bears and Shock move from A's hand to A's graveyard, and A's hand is empty. Harness Infinity is exiled.

variants.label: empty_hand
variants.delta: A's hand holds only Harness Infinity, which is cast, so A's hand is empty when it resolves.
variants.expected: The exchange still happens: Hill Giant moves from A's graveyard to A's hand, and A's graveyard is empty. Harness Infinity is exiled.

scenarios.forge_notes: The 701.12d ownership clause is exercised by 701.12d-2.

scenarios.title: Cards in two zones are exchanged only if the same player owns them all

setup.notes: A owns Arcanum Wings in the base variant. A controls Arcanum Wings through Confiscate in every variant. In the owned_by_opponent variant B cast Arcanum Wings on A's Grizzly Bears earlier and A then took control of it with Confiscate.

decisions: A activates Aura swap on Arcanum Wings ({2}{U}), tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A chooses Holy Strength.

variants.label: owned_by_controller
variants.expected: Arcanum Wings returns to A's hand and Holy Strength enters the battlefield attached to Grizzly Bears. Grizzly Bears is 3/4 without flying. Confiscate goes to A's graveyard in the next state-based check.

variants.label: owned_by_opponent
variants.delta: Arcanum Wings is owned by B instead of A.
variants.expected: No exchange occurs. Arcanum Wings stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which is 2/2 with flying, and Holy Strength stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's ZoneExchangeEffect does nothing unless the activating player owns the Aura on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Swapping an attached Aura with an Aura card in hand moves the attachment to the new card
decisions: A activates Aura swap on Arcanum Wings ({2}{U}), tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: aura_in_hand
variants.expected: Arcanum Wings returns to A's hand and Holy Strength enters the battlefield attached to Grizzly Bears. Grizzly Bears is 3/4 without flying.

variants.label: no_aura_in_hand
variants.delta: A's hand holds Giant Growth instead of Holy Strength.
variants.expected: No exchange occurs. Arcanum Wings stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which is 2/2 with flying.

scenarios.title: Exchanging a life total with a toughness value sets the toughness and changes the life total

setup.notes: In the cannot_gain_life variant Everlasting Torment is added to B's battlefield.

decisions: A activates Tree of Perdition ({T}) targeting B.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: opponent_below
variants.expected: B's life total goes from 7 to 13. Tree of Perdition's toughness is set to 7 and it is 0/7.

variants.label: opponent_above
variants.delta: B's life total is 20 instead of 7.
variants.expected: B's life total goes from 20 to 13. Tree of Perdition's toughness is set to 20 and it is 0/20.

variants.label: cannot_gain_life
variants.delta: Everlasting Torment is on the battlefield under B's control (players can't gain life).
variants.expected: No part of the exchange occurs: B stays at 7 and Tree of Perdition stays 0/13.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's LifeExchangeVariantEffect returns without changing the life total or the toughness when the player can't gain (or lose) the life the exchange needs.

scenarios.title: Exchanging text boxes gives each creature the other's rules text
decisions: A casts Exchange of Words, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Exchange of Words resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its enters trigger targets Grizzly Bears and Typhoid Rats.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: text_with_ability
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has deathtouch (Typhoid Rats' text) and Typhoid Rats has no abilities (Grizzly Bears' empty text). Both keep their own power, toughness and creature types: Grizzly Bears 2/2, Typhoid Rats 1/1.

variants.label: both_vanilla
variants.delta: B's creature is Hill Giant instead of Typhoid Rats.
variants.expected: Both text boxes are empty, so nothing changes: Grizzly Bears 2/2 and Hill Giant 3/3, neither with abilities.

variants.label: target_destroyed
variants.delta: With the trigger on the stack, B casts Shock targeting Typhoid Rats, tapping Mountain, and Shock resolves first.
variants.expected: Typhoid Rats is destroyed. The exchange cannot be completed, so Grizzly Bears keeps its empty text and has no deathtouch.
